exceptions.reason: Three of the AS3 interface's members are declared in terms of LibraryLoader, the AS3 SWF downloader. That is the edge that drags the loader stack into any closure naming a library. This keeps the members that read a loaded library and drops the ones that fetch one; loading is the port's own concern.
exceptions.state: seam -- AS3 counterpart deliberately not converted

exceptions.reason: Turns a library SWF into an AssetLibrary of named bitmaps. Flash got this from Loader plus the SymbolClass tag binding each character to a class; with no player, the port has to read the container and register the exports itself. Every avatar part is addressed by its exported name, so this mapping is the whole contract between the asset SWFs and the compositor.
exceptions.state: platform exception -- no AS3 counterpart
